name: Ryzor UX Insights
author: sentineldev1212

sections.description:
Ryzor UX Insights is a lightweight, privacy‑focused UX event logger for WordPress.

It tracks user interactions such as clicks, scroll depth, and time‑on‑page, then displays them in a clean, modern dashboard with filters, pagination, and CSV export.

All data is stored locally inside your WordPress database.
No external servers. No telemetry. No user profiling.

Perfect for site owners who want simple, fast, privacy‑friendly UX analytics.

Features

  • Click tracking
  • Scroll depth tracking
  • Time‑on‑page tracking
  • Modern dashboard UI
  • Filters for event type, date range, and search
  • Pagination for large datasets
  • CSV export (filtered or full)
  • Local‑only storage (no external API calls)
  • Lightweight JS logger
  • Admin settings page with toggle controls
  • System status page with health checks
  • Event log with advanced filtering
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Ryzor UX Insights → Settings to enable logging
  4. Visit Ryzor UX Insights → Dashboard to view events
sections.faq:
Does this track users across sites?

No. Ryzor UX Insights only logs interactions on your own WordPress site.

Does this send data to external servers?

No. All data stays inside your WordPress database.

Can I export events?

Yes — CSV export is built in.

Does this affect site performance?

No. The logger is lightweight and optimized for minimal impact.
